title: Which limits are worth paying to relax
heading: A Negative Price Is the Marginal Cost of a Commitment
cases: an offer's gain is its row's price times the change, less its cost, over all its units, and offers that lose are dropped
one unit bought may move its row by many row units, as a crew-month adds hundreds of $k of capacity
relaxing a requirement lowers its right-hand side, and a negative price times a negative change is a gain
offers are ranked by total gain over their units, not by gain per unit
